purpose: Generation 10 readiness derived from seven real LeafGreen ROM/SAV pairs and the linked Generation III modern-core contract.

modern_core.activation_rule: GEN_LATEST remains GEN_9 until Generation 10 rules and data are verified

source_adapter.inventory_status: core species/ability/item/move/name/evolution table bases inventoried for all seven ROMs
source_adapter.address_policy: per-profile addresses only; never copy an absolute address from one region/revision into another
source_adapter.evolution_note: the table base is found from a source-derived binary prefix; exact base-pointer scan is zero, so relocation requires instruction/literal-pool review

expanded_half.use: future source-built/relocated data and assets; code placement still needs branch-range review

oversize_probe.result: 64/96/128 MiB files are probe-only without a custom mapper

observed_checksum_span.Japan_warning: BPGJ ROM header says 0x3D40 while the supplied newest SAV slot validates only at 0x3D68; retain both facts and do not rewrite the Japanese format from inference

saveblock2_extension_candidate.status: capacity candidate only; retail read/write hooks are not implemented

retail_identifier_storage.moves: u16 in Pokémon move slots; retail LevelUpMove encoding is only 9 bits
retail_identifier_storage.abilities: u8 IDs with a one-bit boxed selector
retail_identifier_storage.evolution: u16 method + u16 param + u16 target species

target_modern_core_storage.species_and_move_widening: deferred until verified new data requires a wider serialized field

implementation_order: keep Generation 10 reserved after GEN_CHAMPIONS while GEN_LATEST stays GEN_9
validate all seven source ROM/SAV profiles and preserve their provenance
use manifests/core_table_inventory.csv as the LeafGreen source-adapter baseline
keep normal ROM builds inside the 32 MiB GBA hard limit
preserve the physical 128 KiB save and special sectors
perform instruction-aware relocation of retail core tables only after every reference class is inventoried
replace the retail 9-bit level-up move encoding in any retail-binary compatibility path before IDs above 511 are used
widen ability/effect paths only with an explicit serialization/interoperability design
activate real Generation 10 data only after authoritative data exists
resume form-change mechanics after the capacity layer is stable
